title: nOSS scene tags
description: scene/tags.json inside a .nosstrack made from a 3D scene (Track Fitting): what each part of scene/scene.glb is to a car. A surface's tag is its mesh's (by node name), else its material's (by name), else the first rule whose pattern matches its mesh or material name, else the default. See docs/TRACK_EDITOR.md §7.1.

rules.description: In order: a pattern ('*' for any run of characters, case ignored) against mesh and material names.

meshes.description: Mesh node name to tag; overrides its materials'.

default.description: Untagged surfaces. auto: solid, and driven on as concrete.

style.description: own: the scene's materials as they are; retro: textures made small and sharp to match retro_ps2.
